name: Promptly - AI Video Editor
description: AI video editor for iPhone creators. Upload a talking-head clip, describe the vibe you want, get a polished TikTok, Reel, or YouTube Short in under a minute. Captions, cuts, zoom effects, transitions, motion graphics, B-roll, and sound effects — all automated.
